summary: Implement technical SEO improvements for the Gadget Zone website (meta tags, semantic headings, anchors, schema, canonical, Open Graph) without changing visual design or layout.
architectural_notes: SEO changes must not alter UI appearance: do not move sections, do not modify hero text/layout, do not regenerate images.

existing_features.title: Update the site-level SEO meta tags in frontend/index.html to exactly match the provided Meta Title and Meta Description, without affecting UI appearance.

Fix heading semantics in the React page content so there is exactly one H1 with text "Gadget Zone", and use H2 tags for the main sections: "Brands We Deal With", "Products & Services", "Why Choose Us", "HOT PICK", and "Store Gallery". Use H3 only inside sections if needed, and do not change any displayed text content, styling, or section order.

Add internal anchor links for in-page navigation without changing layout: (a) each Product & Service card links to its respective description section, (b) the HOT PICK button links to the HOT PICK content section, and (c) the footer includes anchor links to Products, Services, and Contact.

Add LocalBusiness structured data (JSON-LD) to frontend/index.html (or another static head injection approach) including: Business Name (Gadget Zone), Address (Thiruvanmiyur, Chennai, Tamil Nadu), Phone number and WhatsApp, Business hours, and Services offered, without affecting UI appearance.
Add a canonical link tag in frontend/index.html pointing to the main site URL using the non-www version. Use the homepage URL already used in frontend/public/sitemap.xml as the canonical href.

Add Open Graph tags in frontend/index.html for social sharing, including og:title, og:description, and og:image, using the provided title/description and an existing site image asset (do not regenerate images).

Add LocalBusiness structured data (name, address, phone/WhatsApp, hours, services)
